DROP YOUR PHOTOS HERE
=====================

This folder is served at the site root by Vite. To add Hubrah's photos,
place image files here using these exact names — the layout will pick them
up automatically (no code changes needed):

  portrait.jpg     -> Hero portrait (right side of the landing screen)
                      Best as a vertical / portrait crop (e.g. 1200 x 1500).

  portrait-2.jpg   -> About section photo
                      Portrait or square crop works well (e.g. 1200 x 1400).

Until these files exist, an elegant "HS" monogram placeholder is shown.

Tips:
  - .jpg is expected. If you only have .png, either rename it to .jpg
    (most browsers don't care about the extension) or update the `src`
    prop in src/sections/HeroSection.vue and AboutSection.vue.
  - Keep files reasonably sized (under ~500 KB each) for fast loading.
